items.summary: Replace all user-facing occurrences of the string "Admin Portal" with "Saddam Chat" across the frontend, including (at minimum) the app header, screen titles/headings, and the HTML document title/meta in frontend/index.html.

Update post-login redirect logic so that after a successful login: super_admin redirects to /chat by default; admin redirects to /chat; approved non-admin users redirect to /chat; only unapproved non-admin users redirect to /pending-approval. Ensure admin/super_admin never get sent to the Pending Approval screen due to an approval flag check order.

Ensure the User Management screen at route /admin/users is accessible from the Chat experience via the header dropdown menu for super_admin users (i.e., from the Chat screen header menu, super_admin can navigate to /admin/users).

Remove any routing/guard behavior that blocks super_admin or admin users behind dashboard-only screens (e.g., do not force admins to land on /admin or require visiting /admin before accessing other allowed routes). Admin and super_admin should be able to access /chat and other non-authenticated routes permitted by login without being redirected to dashboard-only pages.

Ensure super_admin always has access to the user list (/admin/users) without being routed through or blocked by the approval flow (Pending Approval). Any approval gating must apply only to non-admin users.
